chunks.title: Garanti BBVA (Garanti BBVA) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Garanti BBVA is a Turkish Commercial Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official Global Banking Partner of COP31 Antalya (with BBVA Group); 60+ Green Zone Climate Finance Hub sessions; EV/TOGG mobility showcase. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: TRY 3.5 trillion sustainable finance commitment (2018–2029; >TRY 1 trillion surpassed by Jan 2026) for green transition, renewables, e-mobility & SMEs. Source verification: https://www.garantibbva.com.tr/en/corporate-communications/cop31-climate-change-summit.

chunks.title: Garanti BBVA Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Garanti BBVA provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Investment Loan, Sustainability-Linked Loan, SME Green Transformation Loan, EV/E-Mobility Finance, Green Trade Finance. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 100,000 to USD 150,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, SME, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Project SPV, Climate-Tech Startup.

chunks.title: Garanti BBVA Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Garanti BBVA: Renewable Energy, Clean Transport & EV, Industrial Decarbonization, SME Green Transition, Water Management & Circular Economy, Green Buildings. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye, EMEA. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Garanti BBVA Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Garanti BBVA's application form: Turkish company registration (VKN) & audited financials; Garanti BBVA Sustainable Finance Framework eligibility; Environmental permits (ÇED/EIA) & energy/carbon savings verification; Collateral / creditworthiness or KGF guarantee package. Explicit exclusion rules: New thermal coal projects; Environmental regulation breaches. Official application portal: https://www.garantibbva.com.tr/en/sustainability.

chunks.title: Garanti BBVA Form Template: Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application
chunks.text: Garanti BBVA uses the 'Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application' workflow governed by BRSA (BDDK) Sustainable Banking Guidelines, Turkish Green Taxonomy & EU CBAM Readiness. Typical review timeline is 1–4 weeks (Branch/Corporate RM Intake -> Green Eligibility Check -> Credit Approval). Form sections required: 1. Applicant Identification, 2. Product Selection, 3. Green Technical Criteria, 4. Credit & Collateral, 5. Compliance, 6. Summary.
